title: 菊花賞の後に・ボクが三冠ウマ娘！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having just crushed the Kikuka Sho, Tokai Teio thrusts three fingers up in the air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has become a Triple Crown champion, just like her beloved Symboli Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her journey isn't over yet. In order to surpass Symboli Rudolf, Tokai Teio sets her sights on the spring Tenno Sho.
